import_modules_from_strings: import Python modules from a list of dotted module name strings with optional failure tolerance
cast_iterable_elements: cast all elements of an iterable to a target type and return as a list or tuple
check_sequence_types: check whether a sequence contains only items of an expected type using is_seq_of
slice_and_concat_lists: slice a list into sublists by given lengths or concatenate a list of lists into one flat list
check_prerequisites_decorator: decorate a function to require specific Python packages or executables before it runs
